entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about some cycling shoes I bought recently. I'm just so sad about it, they're not working out at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference issue?

I don't think they're broken, but they're just... painful. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for so long, and I'm just really disappointed.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I completely understand your frustration. To see what my options are, could I please get your order number?
Of course. It's VF-99147B. I just feel so bad, I really needed this money for some other things, you know? I hate to be a bother.

It's no bother at all, that's what I'm here for. Thank you for that number. Let me just pull up your order... Okay, I see you purchased the Aero-Stride cycling shoes, and they were delivered 22 days ago. Let me just double-check our policy.
Alright, I've confirmed it. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. We don't want you stuck with a product that's causing you pain.
Oh, really? Wow. That's... such a relief. I was so worried I'd just have to throw them out. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just place the shoes back in the box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. You've really made my day. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
